visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a bright indoor gym, a man with a large dark afro hairstyle and tattooed arms is seated at a lat pulldown machine. He wears a dark blue t-shirt with a Gold's Gym logo and is pulling the metal bar down with an expression of intense effort. A man with short bleached hair stands behind him, gesturing and observing. (2) The scene cuts to the afro-haired man performing seated cable rows and standing dumbbell curls. His facial expressions are exaggeratedly strained as he trains. The background features gym mirrors and various weight machines under even studio-like lighting. (3) The man is then shown sitting on a leg press machine, but he is leaning forward and pulling the handles with his hands to perform a rowing motion instead of using his legs. The coach stands by, looking on with a skeptical posture. (4) The final sequence shows the bleached-haired coach jokingly choking the afro-haired man. The man looks into the camera with a comical, pained grimace, while yellow and white subtitles appear on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic meme portraying the common gym trope of wanting to skip 'leg day.' It uses a humorous contrast between a sad, sentimental Mandopop song and visual scenes of a trainee attempting to cheat his workout by using leg machines for upper body exercises. The video ends with a funny confrontation where his coach catches and punishes him, aiming to entertain the fitness community through relatability and slapstick humor.
